description: This file is a shell script for performance testing of git repository operations, such as calculating ahead-behind counts, checking merged refs, and verifying base commit relationships using custom test utilities and git commands.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large git repository with various references, tags, and commits for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a descriptive label and commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a specific performance test with a descriptive label and command sequence.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
